## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -v` passes when applicable
- [ ] `python DrawBot.py --self-test` passes when applicable
- [ ] Preview still works and can be cancelled
- [ ] Draw can start/stop safely
- [ ] Profile settings remain isolated
- [ ] GPU-off / CPU fallback still works when relevant

## Rendering changes

For drawing-engine changes, explain the effect on image quality, real draw time and coverage. Avoid claiming an improvement based only on lower stroke count.

## Additional context

Add logs, before/after measurements or reproduction details when useful.
